# 1 Enoch Chapter 11 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of the Watchers

---

**1** And then the whole earth shall be tilled in righteousness, and shall all be planted with trees and filled with blessing.

**2** And all desirable trees shall be planted upon it, and vines shall be planted upon it; and the vine planted there shall yield wine in abundance. And as for all the seed that is sown upon it, each measure sown shall bear a thousandfold, and each measure of olives shall yield ten presses of oil.

---

*LOGOS notes: Chapter 11 is a brief eschatological promise — two verses describing the renewal of the earth after judgment. The passage draws on the tradition of paradise restoration (cf. Amos 9:13; Isa 65:17–25). The hyperbolic yields (thousandfold grain, ten presses of oil per measure) are characteristic of Second Temple eschatological abundance language.*
